snippet.title: Abort Sequence - Gameplay Trailer
snippet.description:
Wishlist "Abort Sequence" on Steam! 
- https://store.steampowered.com/app/5048190/Abort_Sequence

Scour your desk, find the right pages and decipher their content to find the defusal codes in this fast-paced puzzle experience!
Beat multiple difficulties, optimize your solving strategies and find the right codes among thousands of possible combinations!

Join our Discord server to keep up with any new update:
- https://discord.gg/KxXxW2z6uG
